Q: Why am I unable to log in to Help Center on iOS devices? A: Sometimes users encounter login issues when accessing the Help Center on their iOS device or using Safari. These issues are caused by the "Prevent cross-site tracking" setting, which blocks certain login data from being saved during the redirection process. This setting needs to be disabled in order for users to log in using Safari because the login process relies on cross-site tracking. By default, this setting is turned on, but users can manually disable it to resolve the issue. Apple's Help Center provides instructions on how to disable this setting, which can be found in the articles "Prevent cross-site tracking in Safari on Mac" or "Browse privately in Safari on iPhone". What is the difference between CLO and Marvelous Designer?

Although the core technology behind the solutions are the same, Marvelous Designer is primarily used in the CG, animation, and gaming industries. CLO is a more robust solution geared towards the fashion and apparel industries with functions that can be applied to various stages of the garment design development process. The primary difference between the two solutions is that the import/export of DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM files in CLO, allows for production-ready patterns to be sent to your manufacturer. Why is CLO not performing as quickly as anticipated despite having more than 4 CPU cores?

CLO's program speed increases with faster Core clock speed and more Cores. However, there is NO significant speed advancement when there are more than 4 Cores compared to the program speed ran with four Cores. Therefore, to be cost-effective, we recommend hardware with four Cores, each Core's speed being between 3.5 ~4.0 Ghz or faster. [https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001049088]

What are the steps involved in registering an avatar accessory in version 7.3?

Objective Register an avatar accessory file or convert a pattern into an accessory. Location Main Menu Avatar Register Accessory Operation Open the CLO avatar file. Click the tool/menu indicated. Register Accessory window appears. After setting the options below, click the Save button. Menu Description Basic Accessory Type Select the type of the accessory.(Hair, Shoes, Earring, Glasses) Object Select the type of the object (file and pattern) to register. Option Mirror Creation If you register shoes and earrings, it automatically creates the opposite object. Inverted relative to the central axis of the avatar. Thumbnail Auto Apply the thumbnail image automatically. Custom Apply the desired image as the thumbnail. Save File window appears. Set the file name and path. What is linked editing and how does it enhance collaborative writing processes?

List of Contents Setting Edit Options and Properties Objective You can quickly edit multiple patterns together by linking different pattern outlines. Operation Setting Click the 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern (Z) tool. Click one of the two segments to be edited simultaneously, or select multiple segments simultaneously while holding down the Shift key on the keyboard, and Right-click Link Lines menu. Move the mouse cursor to click the opposite segment you want to edit simultaneously, or hold down the Shift key on your keyboard and click multiple segments. Linked editing is set to both selected segments. Note : If the pattern has already been sewn, you can connect it more easily by right-clicking on the sewing line with the 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing(B) tool clicking the Link Lines menu. Even if it is not sewing, we recommend sewing first and setting Link Lines if necessary. Edit Edit one side of the segment set for linked editing with 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern (Z) tool. Based on the edited segment, the opposite segment is edited in the same direction in a symmetrical direction. Options and Properties Click the 2D Toolbar Edit Link tool. Right-click on the segment set for linking and apply options as needed. Unlink Remove the linked editing. Flip Direction Set to be simultaneously edited in the same direction. Note: You can also apply it in the property editor by clicking on the linked editing segment. Add Sewing to Linking If there is no sewing line, a sewing line is added based on both lines set for linked editing. [https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/24228902330265]
